# Tobit Chapter 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Tobit 6 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/TOB_006_page_001.jpg

---

**6:1** And as he-went, and the-dog ran with him, and he-lodged the-first night at-the river Tigris.

**6:2** And the-young-man went-down to-wash his-feet in-the river Tigris, and a-large fish leaped from the-water and sought to-devour the-foot of-the-young-man. And he-cried-out.

**6:3** And the-angel said to-him, "Seize-hold of-the fish." And the-young-man seized-hold of-the fish and drew-it up onto-the land.

**6:4** And the-angel said to-him, "Split open the-fish and take out its-heart and its-liver and its-bile and keep them safely with-you."

**6:5** And the-young-man did as-the-angel had-commanded him; and he-split-open the-fish and gathered together its-heart and its-liver and its-bile. And he-roasted a-portion of-the fish and he-ate [it], and the-rest he-salted and kept.

And they-journeyed on together until they-drew-near to-Media.

**6:6** And the-young-man asked the-angel and said to-him, "Azariah, brother, what [is] the-heart and the-liver and the-bile of-the fish — for what [use is] the-healing from them?"

**6:7** And he-said to-him, "The-heart and the-liver — if any-one is-tormented by a-demon or an-evil spirit, one-must smoke these [before] him and the-person will-be-free from all torment forevermore.

**6:8** And the-bile — anoint with-it a-man who has-whiteness in-his-eyes, and he-will-be-healed."

**6:9** And when they-were-drawing-near to-Media and were-already approaching Ecbatana,

**6:10** Raphael said to-the-young-man Tobias, "Brother Tobias." And he-said, "Here-I-am." And he-said to-him, "On this-night we-must lodge at-Raguel's — he-is your-kinsman — and he-has a-daughter named Sarah.

**6:11** He-has no-other son or daughter except Sarah alone, and you are-the-heir to-all his-possessions; the-girl is-sensible, courageous, and very-beautiful, and her-father is-a-good man.

**6:12** He-said, "You have-the-right to-take her. Therefore hear-me, brother, and I-will-speak this-night to-her-father about the-girl, that she-may-be-given to-you as-your-bride. And when we-return from Rages, we-will-celebrate-the-wedding-of-her. For I-know that Raguel is-not-able to-withhold her from you or to-betroth her to-another-man, for-this would-incur death according-to the-decree of-the-book of-Moses, since you-know that you are-destined to-take her — she-belongs to-you. Listen then, brother, and we-will-speak this-night to-her-father about the-girl and we-will-ask her for-you as-your-bride."

**6:13** And Tobias answered and said to-Raphael, "Brother Azariah, I-have-heard that this-girl has-been-given to-seven men and they-all-died in-the bridal-chamber. On the-night when they-went-in to-her. And I-heard that a-demon kills them.

**6:14** And now I-alone am-afraid, because he-does-nothing to-her but kills every-man who-wishes to-approach her. I am an-only-child to-my-father; if I-die I-will-bring my-father and my-mother down to-their-grave with-grief over-me. And they-have no-other-son to-bury-them."

**6:15** And the-angel said to-him, "Do-you-not remember the-words of-your-father that-he-commanded you to-take a-wife from your-father's-house? And now hear-me, brother, and do-not be-concerned about this-demon, and take her.

**6:16** For I-know that this-night she-will-be-given to-you as-a-wife.

**6:17** And when you-enter-into the-bridal-chamber, take from the-fish-organs the-heart and the-liver and put [them] upon the-smoking-coals of-incense, and the-odor will-spread

**6:18** and the-demon will-smell it and will-flee and will-not return ever again in-the-age. And when you-are-about to-be-with-her, first rise-up both-of-you and pray, and petition the-Lord of-heaven that-mercy and safety may-come-upon-you. And do-not be-afraid, for-she-has-been-assigned to-you from before-the-age, and you-will-save her, and she-will-go with-you, and I-suppose that-you-will-have-children from-her. And do-not-be-troubled."

And when Tobias heard the-words of-Raphael and that-she [was] his-kinswoman from the-seed of-his-father's-house, he-loved-her exceedingly, and his-heart was-clinging to-her.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

- **6:2**: "sought to-devour the-foot" — Greek *katapein ton poda* (swallow/gulp down the foot). This is a large Tigris fish (possibly a catfish). The incident is both realistic and symbolically charged — life is seized where danger lurks.
- **6:4**: Three organs: *kardia* (heart), *hēpar* (liver), *cholē* (bile/gall). The use of fish organs in medicine/magic has parallels in ancient Near Eastern and Mediterranean practice. EMET preserves all three without interpretive addition.
- **6:7**: "smoke these [before] him" — the Greek verb *thymiaō* means to make a burnt offering, to fumigate, to smoke. In context: fumigation ritual. The implied subject is incense smoke + fish organs.
- **6:12**: "death according-to-the-decree of-the-book of-Moses" — refers to the law of levirate inheritance (Num 27:1–11; 36:6–9). Sarah is the last of her line; the nearest male kinsman has right and duty to marry her.
- **6:13**: "in the bridal chamber" — Greek *en tō koitōni* (in the bedroom). The seven dead husbands frame Sarah's situation as a horror but also a narrative problem demanding supernatural solution.
- **6:14**: "bring my-father and my-mother down to-their-grave with grief" — echoes Gen 42:38 (Jacob's fear for Benjamin). The phrase is a Semitic/Hebraic expression for dying of grief.
- **6:18**: "assigned to-you from before-the-age" — Greek *ap' aiōnos* (from eternity/from ages past). This is predestination language: Sarah was always Tobias's appointed bride.
- Final verse of ch. 6: "his heart was-clinging to-her" — Greek *prosekollan*, the same verb used in Gen 2:24 (LXX) for a man cleaving to his wife. Deliberate allusion. — EMET
